test_cython_agg_boolean: test cython aggregation on boolean columns with numeric_only parameter to verify mean computation
test_cython_agg_nothing_to_agg: test cython aggregation error handling when numeric_only=True is used with non-numeric SeriesGroupBy columns
test_cython_agg_return_dict: test cython groupby agg returning dictionary results from lambda functions applied per group
test__cython_agg_general: test the internal _cython_agg_general method against numpy equivalent aggregation functions
test_cython_agg_empty_buckets: test cython aggregation behavior on empty group buckets with observed parameter variations
test_cython_agg_nullable_int: test cython aggregations on nullable integer dtypes and verify dtype preservation compared to float64
test_cython_agg_EA_known_dtypes: test cython aggregation result dtypes for extension arrays including Int64, Float32, Float64, and boolean with NA values
